commands.label: CLASS-GUARD lane: PERMANENT, never selected by what a task happens to touch (maintainer ruling 2026-08-10, DRIFT-199-I001-017). VERDICT-CAPTURE RUNS FIRST and is the reason this lane is not optional: of the four defects existing fixtures caught in one session, three failed toward silencing or nagging, but the over-broad approval rule failed toward FABRICATION - capture inventing an authorization the human never gave. That is the one direction where a miss is unrecoverable, because a false authorization in the ledger is indistinguishable from a real one, so the T032 fabrication fixtures and the 23 not-approve cases must not be guarded only when someone happens to edit capture. The rest guard defect CLASSES structurally across the engine - the one path-identity primitive, the volume-derived case rule, and the machinery-path policy - where the file that breaks them is rarely the file being edited. The path-identity guard DID catch the third instance of its class the moment the call was written; it was simply never run, and a red guard was committed unnoticed. A guard only guards code whose author runs it. Roughly 20 s combined - cheap enough that omitting it can never be justified by budget. Membership guard added 2026-08-26 (maintainer ruling): it LISTS and COMPARES rather than executing, so it costs seconds and belongs in the fast lane - a suite written into no lane fails here immediately, which is what stops the next one being written into silence. Package-completeness guard added 2026-08-30: the batch added exactly two machinery files and BOTH were absent from Specrew.psd1's FileList, so both were fully tested, fully mirrored, parity-clean - and reached no downstream project at all. The package IS the FileList; this guard COMPUTES the omission set rather than listing files to check, because a hand-enumerated guard over a hand-enumerated manifest repeats the defect one layer up. Per-event hook coverage added 2026-08-30: on Codex CLI, SessionStart and Stop receipts existed, UserPromptSubmit receipts never did, and health reported healthy because it classifies aggregate liveness rather than asking whether every DECLARED event has one. Specrew rendered orientation and packets while recording no typed authorization at all. Both sets were already computable and nothing compared them - the same shape as the FileList omission. Refusal-attribution guard added 2026-08-30: a workshop rejected for an underscore in a binding NAME was told about its VALUE, shown a value that was valid, and given casing advice irrelevant to underscores - the fifth measured instance of a refusal that accurately describes what it checked and misdescribes what went wrong. Silent-drop guard added 2026-08-31: a valid human authorization was matched, rejected for length, and discarded with no message - the capture reads the rationale as everything to end-of-message. A phrase that matched and was then rejected must say so and say what to do; a phrase that never matched stays silent.

commands.label: SLICE lane: the suites this slice touches, plus the workshop-authority suites added 2026-08-17. The beta3 workshop fixes (W10-W18) shipped with no lane covering them, so a walk regression could only be caught by someone remembering to run them by hand - the same 'a guard only guards code whose author runs it' shape the class-guard lane exists to prevent. The full deterministic registry is the RELEASE GATE lane and runs at the certification round, not on every slice (maintainer ruling 2026-08-10). The W29-W32 review-frame suite joined 2026-08-20: those four defects let a review be recorded as clean and independent while its frame held one planning document, so the guard belongs where a slice touching review machinery runs it. W33's declared-coverage suite joined it 2026-08-20: it is the only guard standing between a review that read nothing and a recorded clean pass, and it spans the candidate contract, the ingest degrade and the store's allowed-field list. W34's authorship and derived-independence suites joined 2026-08-20; they span the hook that observes the write, the store derivation, and the validator that recomputes it. The packaging-identity suite joined 2026-08-21: it pins the two mechanisms that turned out not to exist - a supported local install, and a build stamp derived from what is actually in the package. PARALLELIZED 2026-08-24 (DRIFT-199-I001-116): the lane grew past its own budget - 24 sequential child pwsh spawns measured 370s cold in a faithful frozen-tree materialization against a 480s bound, and two review launches died on exactly that timeout. The suites are isolated processes on GUID-scoped temp fixtures, so they now run 6 at a time; the result count is pinned so a swallowed suite cannot read as a pass. Measured cold+env-scrubbed after: 199s, giving the 480s bound 2.4x headroom, inside the project's own measured-headroom convention. Cycle-reset guard added 2026-08-30: the truth gate replayed the GLOBAL last-authorized boundary into a NEW iteration, forward-writing its plan scaffold from planning to complete and wedging every next-iteration cycle. No existing mirror fixture crossed a cycle boundary, so nothing saw it.

Iteration 003 explicit governance validation - the ACTIVE iteration. RE-POINTED 2026-08-31 for the SECOND time (DRIFT-199-I003-007, the recurrence DRIFT-199-I002-015 predicted). Iteration 002 closed under its closeout verdict, and a complete iteration is held to a higher bar than a running one, so 002 began failing on two findings that CANNOT be repaired without editing a sealed iteration: a missing Completed date in plan.md, and its planning-time hardening-gate concerns now demanding runtime evidence. This is exactly what happened to 001 and exactly what that entry said would happen again: a verification plan that names a specific iteration goes stale the moment the next one opens, and the closeout does not re-point it. Second occurrence in one feature. Beta4 owns making the closeout re-point this, or making the command name the active iteration rather than a number.
